result.keyword: What's the best HR software for a small company?
result.markdown:
For a small company, I'd recommend **BambooHR, Employment Hero, or Rippling**, depending on what you need HR software to do.

The biggest consideration is whether you want a simple employee-management system or a complete HR platform covering onboarding, performance, time off, payroll, and compliance.

## My top 5 HR software recommendations

![BambooHR Pricing Tiers & Costs (Updated for 2026)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/lfGhQCVpJQbVf41B3vtRX6UWHPJMlOVTkV5Lya9yPIISkiwns_htURwqMmTW1XKVeOlzwGtSwMoAy6xHZfLSsDRbj_k8ukNFpuVVacxjpUmUJ8OulZgM7uKaXXq0t7AgyNBI0lwdAtl5FOEEJtWnohYZhANModEpYKzGNdOVx23nOO8vpFEk1sa8a024E67p?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. BambooHR**

(Best overall for HR)

Great for employee records, onboarding, time-off tracking, performance reviews, reporting, and employee self-service.

Best for companies wanting organized, professional HR without unnecessary complexity.

Pricing: Quote-based; small-team minimums may apply.

[BambooHR website](https://www.bamboohr.com/)

---

![Employment Hero revenue, funding & news | Sacra](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/fzjrXPaeDGwbU0ktEn3_TQOhXXDHf36IZVXODrp9T7HoPtffJn3log8dcNXgqmxNTVoSA7Z8uruA7pqFNxyUEhGcStTX98s15F3_UqZVdwX3Hil0ScIjHbsYgq5CRV83FbCLkZXcqjEJTHBYwixjaLt2P4LznFNYwuYqYTuorQs3fGdTLjy3xRq6ouhsJUWG?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Employment Hero**

(Best for Canadian and international SMBs to investigate)

HR management, onboarding, employee documents, performance, leave management, and workforce tools.

Particularly worth considering if you want a broader HR platform.

[Employment Hero website](https://employmenthero.com/)

---

![#1 Workforce Management System - Gong Collective](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/6qeGsApk2jIdFyoxTSygvm7DexVcRwsdAMy-654nhQtsS9qblmlI3_rlyRsZYYkAZppbxudJa7sWDHqPbmVa4ApGBm0HQ-Ug4zK3bKSWGz9BUa-Xw79ufdKKevGKKSwz6wXnJf7tmhQAv7jp_2IhhmpGMf4r2A4gxIyk--T1g2YbjSd8UAKymDETIYyyT6m-?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Rippling**

(Best for automation)

Combines HR, payroll, employee onboarding, benefits, and IT administration.

Excellent if you expect to grow and want multiple business functions connected.

Pricing: Modular, generally quote-based.

[Rippling website](https://www.rippling.com/)

---

![HiBob Company Profile – Israel Office | Secret Tel Aviv](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/VqtrRaPcgUicXO-4Ys0LiaPCrKe-5CJsa6TkSYgK1KcefpQhkEpEHerjMriA1N5YlEChNgmd7rQjSw27yQX48bFCzMJuRS79dEcVkcuDFBzyX6mwJYyF0haiasPADaDYIeAoykjLgSELovlBtSVFVxZrjW7VMjyk6qPW9KpNiwrWMbEgzHfDR3XQ7fQVHM0g?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. HiBob**

(Best for employee engagement)

Strong employee experience, performance management, engagement surveys, company culture, and people analytics.

Particularly good for growing teams with a focus on employee development.

[HiBob website](https://www.hibob.com/)

---

![Introducing Zoho People 5.0 | Streamlined & secure HR software](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/N2tyoCYDXo_2X8HD_5-SWCfDBpBrfnJxvS27zq0luRDcSBxvb5ksF8GIcSrns-PjyFB81AcM6r9iE-CSXiUONYeUFYVq66I46rVVwsJXPLlWkRDDpj17x51dneUMDGMOeIbB1fDSAq7EtcK5moqwY1sb0xYonWwdnsoigFpIV0zzd1uQR8FzhmzsLBPdP8qA?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Zoho People**

(Best budget option)

Employee database, leave management, attendance, onboarding, performance, and customizable workflows.

Good if you want essential HR functionality without spending a fortune.

[Zoho People website](https://www.zoho.com/people/)

These recommendations reflect current 2026 comparisons of HR platforms. ## Which one would I choose?

| Your priority | My recommendation |
|--------|--------|
| Complete HR management | BambooHR |
| Canadian HR requirements | Employment Hero (verify Canadian coverage) |
| HR + payroll + IT | Rippling |
| Employee engagement | HiBob |
| Affordable HR software | Zoho People |
